account.asOfHint: Replayed from the account's events (event sourcing).
account.notFound: This account does not exist or is not yours.
accounts.noTransfers: No transfers yet. Try one: it crosses all three services live.
callback.failed: Sign-in did not complete (link expired or already used).
deposit.hint: Credits a customer, debits the treasury: a two-line entry.
deposit.title: Cash deposit
error.alreadyDecided: This transfer is no longer awaiting review: another analyst already decided.
error.amountInvalid: The amount must be positive, with at most two decimals, and below €1,000,000.
error.amountPositive: The amount must be strictly positive.
error.beneficiaryUnknown: No account at this bank has this IBAN.
error.commentRequired: A comment is required to reject a transfer.
error.idempotencyReused: This idempotency key was already used for another transfer.
error.labelTooLong: The description is limited to 140 characters (SEPA standard).
error.network: The service is unreachable. Check your connection.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Try again in a minute.
error.sameAccount: The beneficiary is the debited account.
error.screeningNotFound: No screening exists for this transfer.
error.sourceAccount: This account to debit is not one of yours.
journal.subtitle: Every movement is an entry whose debits equal its credits. An unbalanced entry is refused by the domain before it reaches the database.
reviews.commentPlaceholder: Customer reached by phone, payment confirmed…
reviews.emptyHint: Sign in as Alice and send more than €3,000: the transfer will show up here in real time.
reviews.rejected: Transfer rejected: funds returned to the customer
reviews.subtitle: Transfers held by the rules. The customer's funds stay on hold until you decide (48 h at most, then automatic rejection).
reviews.title: Fraud review
transfer.keyHint: Sent in the Idempotency-Key header: a double submit never creates two transfers.
transfer.label: Description (optional)
transfer.overdraft: The amount exceeds the available balance ({INTERPOLATION}): the ledger will refuse the hold.
transfer.payeeUnknown: No account at this bank has this IBAN.
transfer.rules: Fraud rules: above €3,000, or €1,000 to a new beneficiary, or more than 3 transfers in 10 minutes, the transfer goes to an analyst. Above €20,000 it is blocked.
transfer.subtitle: Funds are held, screened for fraud, then transferred — or returned if anything fails.
transfer.title: New transfer
transferDetail.label: Description
transferDetail.note: The transfer id is also the hold id and the journal entry id: a replayed message can neither hold nor debit twice.
trial.error: Could not load the trial balance.
trial.subtitle: The bank's treasury is the counterpart of every deposit: all accounts always sum to zero. If they don't, money was created or destroyed.
user.alice: Current and savings accounts: try a large transfer, it goes to review.
user.chloe: Only €640: a €1,000 transfer is refused and the funds are returned.
user.olivia: Decides on suspicious transfers, reads the journal and the trial balance.
welcome.chooseHint: You go through Keycloak (OpenID Connect, PKCE), as on a real banking portal.
welcome.eventsText: The balance at any value date, replayed from events.
welcome.idempotencyText: Double click, timeout, network replay: a transfer is never executed twice.
welcome.lead: Three microservices — ledger, payments, fraud — cooperating through messages, never losing or duplicating a euro, even under concurrent load.
welcome.ledgerText: Every euro comes from somewhere: the trial balance is always zero.
welcome.password: Username pre-filled. Same password for every profile: {START_TAG_CODE}{INTERPOLATION}{CLOSE_TAG_CODE}
welcome.sagaText: Hold, fraud screening, then capture or release of funds, across three services.
welcome.title: A transfer bank {START_TAG_SPAN}where every cent is accounted for.{CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
